$comment: Canned replies for the stand-in platform (demo/fake-platform.js in the case desk engine), so this desk can be tried with no platform. Each key is a case title, matched without regard to case. The stand-in adds its own first line saying that the reply is canned. Each reply has the shape the agent's instructions set (a table of six columns) and follows the right answers in demo-insurer/SCENARIOS.md. The insurer, its customers and their documents are invented. Start the stand-in with DESK_CONFIG pointing at desk.config.json in this folder.
